title: fix: replace deprecated alias with comptime for all constants
body:
## Summary
Replaces all `alias` constant declarations with `comptime` in `websocket.mojo` and `test_websocket.mojo`:
- `WS_OPCODE_*` (6 opcodes), `WS_MAGIC`, `DEFAULT_MAX_*` (3), `WS_CLOSE_*` (3) in `websocket.mojo`
- `TEST_URL`, `MALICIOUS_URL` in `test_websocket.mojo`

`alias` for value constants is deprecated in Mojo 0.26.

## Test plan
- [ ] 23/23 tests pass locally ✅
- [ ] CI passes
